# Services you can connect

<!-- Generated by `go generate ./docs` from internal/catalog/services.yaml. Do not edit by hand. -->

Connect a service from the CLI or the portal's **Services** page. It creates the right
sources (agent tools, polling, webhooks), stores tokens write-only, shows a webhook
secret once, and tests the connection:

```sh
siphon catalog                     # what you can connect on this install
siphon connect linear --token @linear.key --webhook
```

**Available** works now. **Needs package** works once the operator installs the pinned
MCP server (`services.siphon.catalogPackages`); its webhooks work either way. **Not yet**
lists what's missing. Models and subscription logins are on their own pages:
[models](models.md), [logins](logins.md).

## Code hosting

|---|---|---|---|---|
| [GitHub](github.md) | tools, webhooks | available | `siphon connect github` | [`github-ci-failure`](../templates/github-ci-failure.yaml) [`github-issue-triage`](../templates/github-issue-triage.yaml) [`github-pr-review`](../templates/github-pr-review.yaml) |
| [GitLab](gitlab.md) | polling, webhooks | available | `siphon connect gitlab` | [`gitlab-mr-review`](../templates/gitlab-mr-review.yaml) [`gitlab-pipeline-failed`](../templates/gitlab-pipeline-failed.yaml) |
| Bitbucket | tools, webhooks | available | `siphon connect bitbucket` |  |
| Gitea | tools, webhooks | needs package for tools (`catalogPackages = [ "gitea" ]`) | `siphon connect gitea` |  |
| Forgejo | tools, webhooks | needs package for tools (`catalogPackages = [ "forgejo" ]`) | `siphon connect forgejo` |  |
| Azure DevOps |  | not yet: service hooks use basic auth only, and the remote MCP is Entra OAuth only | — |  |

## Chat

| Service | Gives agents | Status | Connect | Templates |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Slack | webhooks | available | `siphon connect slack` | [`slack-mention-agent`](../templates/slack-mention-agent.yaml) |
| Discord |  | not yet: needs an ed25519 signature mode and the PING handshake, and does not cover channel messages | — |  |
| Microsoft Teams |  | not yet: needs a teams-hmac signature mode with a synchronous reply within 5 seconds | — |  |
| Mattermost |  | not yet: the token is in the request body: needs a body-token mode | — |  |
| Matrix |  | not yet: needs PUT requests and a {} reply | — |  |
